name: Tailcat Manager
author: Tailcat Manager
description: Slim Tailcat control from the Omarchy bar: listener status and start/stop/restart, copy-address, self-ping. Devices, identities, diagnostics, and file transfer are managed via the tailcat CLI / an AI agent.

barWidget.description: Start/stop the Tailcat listener and view its status; copy the address to share. Full management (devices, identities, file transfer) happens in the terminal via the tailcat CLI / an AI agent.
